source_summary: Manual motif plan based on the attached Winter 20 MET Chinese winter landscape painting.

motifs.name: misty_upper_snow_mountains
motifs.description: large pale snow-covered mountain mass in the upper half, dissolving into grey winter mist

motifs.name: right_snow_cliff_and_falls
motifs.description: right-side steep snow cliff with dark vertical waterfall or ravine strokes

motifs.name: middle_snow_rock_spires
motifs.description: central middle-ground snow rock spires and rounded boulders rising among trees

motifs.name: bare_winter_tree_cluster
motifs.description: leafless winter trees with fine branching silhouettes in front of snowy rocks

motifs.name: hidden_house_in_grove
motifs.description: small hidden house or pavilion tucked into a dark grove near the lower left

motifs.name: foreground_snow_boulders
motifs.description: large foreground snow-covered boulders and dark shrubs at the lower left

motifs.name: icy_river_and_banks
motifs.description: quiet icy river or winter stream with horizontal banks and pale water bands at the lower right

motifs.name: left_valley_trees_and_path
motifs.description: left middle valley with sparse trees, snowy path, and faint small structures in mist

composition.name: winter_landscape_recombined
composition.theme: a new winter Chinese landscape with snowy mountains, a steep cliff and waterfall, bare trees, a hidden house, foreground boulders, and an icy river
composition.layout: Place the misty mountain mass high in the background, the right cliff as the dominant vertical form, bare winter trees and a hidden house in the middle ground, large snow boulders low left, and the icy river flowing through the lower right.
composition.source_style: Restrained monochrome Chinese winter landscape, grey ink wash, soft snow reserves, sparse brown-red accents, silk-mounted painting tone, and delicate dry-brush winter branches.
